modules.name: shared-types
owns: LeaveType enum (annual, sick, emergency, unpaid, maternity, paternity)
LeaveStatus enum (DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED)
AuditAction enum (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, APPROVE, REJECT)

modules.name: leave
owns: LeaveRequest entity (with state-transition rules: DRAFT→SUBMITTED→APPROVED|REJECTED, and CANCELLED from SUBMITTED)

modules.name: balance
owns: Balance entity (totalEntitlement, usedDays, remainingDays — remainingDays is derived, not stored)

modules.name: policy
owns: LeavePolicy entity (entitlementDays, accrualRate, maxAccumulation, minimumNoticeDays, requiresManagerApproval, isActive)

modules.name: notification
owns: Notification entity (recipientId, type, title, message, status: PENDING|SENT|READ|ARCHIVED)

modules.name: audit
owns: AuditLog entity (entityType, entityId, action, oldValues, newValues, performedBy, performedAt)

recommended_phases.title: Phase 1: Shared types and base infrastructure
recommended_phases.rationale: Zero dependencies. All enums (LeaveType, LeaveStatus, EmploymentStatus, AuditAction), DTOs (CreateLeaveRequestDto, UpdateLeaveRequestDto, LeaveRequestQueryParams), and shared interfaces (BaseEntity, ValidationResult) must exist before any module can reference them.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 2: Employee module
recommended_phases.rationale: Depends only on shared types. Employee entity, repository, service interface, and service implementation. Needed by leave module for employee lookups and manager resolution.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 3: Policy module
recommended_phases.rationale: Depends only on shared types. LeavePolicy entity, repository, service interface, and service implementation. Needed by both balance (entitlement) and leave (validation) modules.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 4: Audit module
recommended_phases.rationale: Depends only on shared types. AuditLog entity, repository, service interface, and service implementation. Required by GP-002 — all state-changing operations must write audit records. Must exist before leave module.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 5: Notification module
recommended_phases.rationale: Depends only on shared types. Notification entity, repository, service interface, and service implementation. Required by leave module for notifying employees and managers on state changes.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 6: Balance module
recommended_phases.rationale: Depends on shared types and policy module. Balance entity, repository, service interface, and service implementation. Must exist before leave module for deduct/restore operations during approval/rejection/cancellation.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 7: Leave module
recommended_phases.rationale: Depends on all prior modules. LeaveRequest entity with state machine, repository, service interface, service implementation (orchestrates policy validation, balance deduction/restoration, audit recording, and notification dispatch), controller, and routes. This is the integration point.

app_notes: Layer boundaries: presentation (controllers/routes) → application (services) → domain (entities with state rules) → infrastructure (repositories, db connection). Dependencies flow inward only. Every service method is defined in an interface before implementation. No circular dependencies — verified: leave depends on balance, policy, employee, notification, audit; balance depends on policy; all depend on shared/types. Shared value types (LeaveType, LeaveStatus, EmploymentStatus, AuditAction, BaseEntity, DTOs) placed in src/shared/types/ per the mechanical rule — they are pure data shapes with no owned behavior used by multiple modules. Entities with lifecycle rules (LeaveRequest state machine, Balance with derived remainingDays) each get their own module directory. GP-002 (audit) and GP-005 (RBAC) are accounted for: every state-changing leave operation records an audit entry; RBAC enforcement is declared at the controller/route layer (manager vs employee roles).

open_questions.question: Should Balance.remainingDays be a stored column or a computed (derived) field?
open_questions.impact: Affects Balance entity design, repository queries, and consistency guarantees. If stored, every deductBalance/restoreBalance must atomically update remainingDays alongside usedDays. If computed, all consumers must use the same formula (totalEntitlement - usedDays) and the field must never be directly written.
candidate_options: Stored column — updated atomically with usedDays in the same transaction; risk of drift if a direct write bypasses the service
Computed/derived — never stored; always calculated as totalEntitlement - usedDays at query time; eliminates drift risk but requires consistent formula usage across all consumers
